means: per edge of each node's route-order DAG: whether the original cold-clear mover reaches the edge's target cells for that piece on that board (cells only, never the spin)

oracle.mode: CC_ORACLE_MOVES=1: libtetris::find_moves, MovementMode::ZeroGComplete, guideline SRS, spawn Row19Or20

classes.corroborated: the target cells are one of cold-clear's resting placements
classes.ours_only: they are not; triaged by reach() with no180 under the edge's own spin filter
classes.tuck: still reachable without a 180: the cc ⊆ ours asymmetry (cold-clear shifts only at rest heights)
classes.i_srs_plus: flag: the piece is I (cold-clear kicks with guideline SRS, the engine with SRS+)
